QUOTE: Compile time (zero overhead): define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO=my_calloc` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO=my_free`. ... Runtime: define only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter, but it never says the two are mutually exclusive. It only notes that the macros can't be combined with `STD_CALLOC`/`STD_FREE`, and the table implies the runtime path applies "only" when the macros are absent. Because it never states exclusivity outright, this resolves to MISS.
